title: CXG 60-2006 — Principles for Traceability / Product Tracing as a Tool Within a Food Inspection and Certification System
notes: Current adopted Codex traceability guidance; Codex defines traceability/product tracing as the ability to follow the movement of food through specified stages of production, processing and distribution. Used as an international transferable traceability principle, not cannabis law. Codex was actively revising CXG 60-2006 in 2026, so this source requires a short re-review interval. Verified against current Codex pages on 2026-09-15.
